programme.title: Battle ATM
programme.desc: Hu Gua, Sandra, and elite challengers join hands to create a brand new puzzle variety show, combining the concept of video games.

programme.title: Super Taste: 48- Hour Burning Desire!
programme.desc: Taiwan's favourite food show returns with a fresh look, more great eats and crazy missions!

programme.title: Discover New Taiwan Step by Step
programme.desc: Hear success stories from Taiwanese in various fields, in this documentary that reveals the vision and passion that drives them to pursue their goals.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical production features George Lam in a humorous tale of a man who seeks love and success in a world of TV commercials, along with his two friends.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: An old grudge between the families of the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung, finally draws a young man back to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Problems ensue after one of two childhood friends who have vowed to become sisters through the exchange of bracelets gets married.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: After enduring several trials (including his girlfriend's rape), a man (Chen Wo-Fu) puts his tai chi skills to deadly use.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: This fascinating, humorous box office smash captures a cross-section of Hong Kong society and their issues -- all crammed into a single tenement building.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: When an argument gets out of hand between a regular Joe and a wealthy businessman, regular Joe finds himself thrust into the middle of a high stakes wager!

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Take a vacation with sexy Lily Ho and Jimmy Lin Chong on a whirlwind tour of Southeast Asia in one of Shaw Brothers most lively 1960's musical romances.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung stars in this riveting swordswoman epic, as he embarks on a quest to find a missing martial arts manual.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Michelle Mei Suet plays Szu-szu, a spoiled girl who leaves her beau Yang Fan, to go off in search of a swordsman whom she idolizes. Whom will she end up with?

programme.title: Killers on Wheels
programme.desc: While taking a ferry on the way to a vacation, Kwok and his family meet a road thug who puts an ugly spin on their holiday plans.

programme.title: Wits of the Brats
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng both co-stars and co-directs his brother Chang Chan-peng in this all-out action comedy featuring the best in the business.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: A young woman's life turns tragic after she discovers that she's adopted and then goes in search of her real mother.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: A murdered emperor's two sons are raised apart but their paths eventually cross, and so do theirs with the imperial throne's usurper.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: A detective's son's attempt to punish a swindler leads to him and his father having their own face-off. Starring Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Actress Lily Ho plays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senseless maiming and her mother's rape. 18 years later, it's payback time.

programme.title: Forever and Ever
programme.desc: Huangmei Opera queen, Ivy Ling Po stars in this tale of a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter a girl who is dying.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: When a top boxer (Lau Kar Leung) refuses to obey an imperial eunuch, other martial arts experts are sent to hunt him down and kill him.

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: Directed by Chow Sze Loke and Li Han Hsiang, this classic starring Diana Chang, Chang Chung and Pai Yun depicts how Lotus Pan marries a midget, yet has an affair.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: A virtuous lone swordsman who is not without individual weaknesses (Ti Lung) finally decides that it's payback time.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60's musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Watch as rival kung-fu schools try to sabotage Fei-hung's superior Pao Chih Lin clinic until the chivalrous philanthropist shows them the error of their ways.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: A beauty is accused of slaying her boyfriends. After fleeing to Lantau Island, she seduces another man there.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: It's Meng Yuan-wen versus Kuan Feng in this wild and wacky wushu saga about a priceless pole with a spectacular secret.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Pat Ting Hung, Carrie Ku Mei and Li Hsiang Chun star in this delightful tale of mistaken identities caused by monogrammed handkerchiefs.

programme.title: Twin Blades of Doom
programme.desc: A man who left the martial world returns to action and goes on the road to vengeance after the evil Ghost Gang kills his parents.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Based on the folk legend, director Li Han Hsiang presents this humorous portrayal of the Emperor Chien Lung's adventures in Jiang Nan.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: Heroes of Sung
programme.desc: In this period action film, Meng Hung (Shih Szu) must work with Fan Tien-Fu (Lo Lieh) to protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: This seminal film adaptation of a 17th century Pu Songling work is the precursor of the famed 'A Chinese Ghost Story'.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: When Kuan, a guard at the Tien Ying Treasury House, falls for his boss's granddaughter, it isn't long before he begins plotting the elimination of his rival.

programme.title: Lover's Rock
programme.desc: This award-winning film is Cheng Pei Pei's screen debut, and depicts life and love in a fishing village captured by two pairs of young lovers.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: Written and directed by Cheng Kang, this classic film starring Yueh Wah depicts how the Sung Dynasty army's chief instructor is framed by a corrupt minister.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: A dying crime lord sends a gang of assassins to steal a special herb that may cure him. However, they become the targets of a couple on a vendetta.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: This Yuan Dynasty tale tells of the Sacred Fire sect, Wu Tang clan, O Mei's disciples, a sacred book, and the destruction of Shaolin.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: A hot-headed patriot gets entwined in the collapse of the Qing Dynasty and the rise of the new Chinese republic.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: A sword-master turned umbrella-maker goes up against a zombie-maker with a 'finger of doom' in this critically acclaimed film.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: This heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers tells the tale of a beautiful shepherdess, whose own problems drag her into a love triangle.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: This hard-hitting drama is based on a real-life investigation on the involvement of both cops as well as crooks in second offences.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: When a detective's bullet changes direction in mid-air to zero in on its target, a terrifying supernatural connection comes to light.

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: An anti-Ching gambling addict (Wang Yu) befriends a man (Gordon Liu), little knowing that his new pal is the emperor in disguise!

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Chinese martial arts student (Wang Yu) trains hard to defeat the karate expert (Lo Lieh) who brutally killed his master and peers.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy.

programme.title: The Boxer From the Temple
programme.desc: A monk nicknamed 'The Kid' finds a barrage of gang fights on his hands after he meets a cruel bandit's son and an abused prostitute.

programme.title: Summer Heat
